data.long_meaning: Ruqaim is a name of Arabic origin meaning 'gentle' and 'kind'. It is derived from the root word 'r-q-m' which implies softness and gentleness. The name Ruqaim carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ruqaim usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
